question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right back, Bob is playing right midfielder, Claire is playing left winger, Dave is playing sweeper, Eve is playing goalkeeper, Fred is playing cheerleader, and Gertrude is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Fred and Dave trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Alice trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Finally, Fred and Dave trade positions. At the end of the match, Gertrude is playing
Options:
(A) right back
(B) right midfielder
(C) left winger
(D) sweeper
(E) goalkeeper
(F) cheerleader
(G) right winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: right back, right midfielder, left winger, sweeper, goalkeeper, cheerleader, right winger
1. Eve ↔ Gertrude: right back, right midfielder, left winger, sweeper, right winger, cheerleader, goalkeeper
2. Fred ↔ Dave: right back, right midfielder, left winger, cheerleader, right winger, sweeper, goalkeeper
3. Dave ↔ Gertrude: right back, right midfielder, left winger, goalkeeper, right winger, sweeper, cheerleader
4. Bob ↔ Eve: right back, right winger, left winger, goalkeeper, right midfielder, sweeper, cheerleader
5. Gertrude ↔ Alice: cheerleader, right winger, left winger, goalkeeper, right midfielder, sweeper, right back
6. Alice ↔ Claire: left winger, right winger, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right midfielder, sweeper, right back
7. Fred ↔ Dave: left winger, right winger, cheerleader, sweeper, right midfielder, goalkeeper, right back
Gertrude is playing right back, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
